from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted legal information for a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural nature of the document (e.g., '二审行政裁定', '刑事申诉审查')")
    administrative_subject: str | None = Field(description="The administrative agency or authority involved (e.g., '人社局', '房屋征收办')")
    administrative_acts: list[str] = Field(description="List of administrative actions or disputes described (e.g., '房屋征收', '行政处罚', '强制拆除')")
    criminal_charges: list[str] = Field(description="List of criminal charges if the document involves criminal law (e.g., '受贿罪')")
    core_dispute: str | None = Field(description="A brief description of the core legal conflict or claim")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for the parsed information of the input document(s)."""
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
